verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves both prior major findings. The comments and public skill now explicitly limit the byte-identity test to an encoding property, acknowledge unconditional V2 dispatch and per-block frame-origin work, state that decode cost has not been benchmarked, and make the default-format decision depend only on the deterministic adverse size result. The two tests are non-vacuous: they require reset_d1 rows for both corpus comparisons, demonstrate both size directions across all six permutations, span multiple blocks for the no-reset identity case, and confirm encoder divergence on reset-bearing input. The implementation confirms that V1 and V2 differ only at the reset_d1 payload. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue remains in the supplied diff.
